notes_for_editor: The record shows a 1942 withdrawal for a lookout and horse pasture, not a confirmed build. The Sawtooth history says nothing more is known about the site and calls it a Lookout in the text but a Ranger Station in its table; the story says so. The 90-acre figure is from the Forest Lookouts page; I did not find it in the history text. No source describes a structure, staffing, fires or the site today. Do not confuse with Grouse Creek Point (Idaho County, 45.68257, -115.10234; a camp, per firelookout.org) or with Grouse Creek Peak (Custer County, Challis NF; separate record). A Grouse Butte trail appears on Gaia GPS listings in search results; I did not read it and did not cite it. The PLSS location and the record coordinates were not checked against a survey plat.
